Matlock’s trip to the Windy City to defend a 1960’s radical accused of murdering Chicago’s mayor comes to a head in the second part of this dramatic two-part episode.

Matlock takes the case of Ken Wilson, convicted of murdering his wife, whose body was never found. Recently released from prison after seven years, Wilson sets out to find his missing wife but gets arrested again.
A disappearing diary, a missing mistress and a preposterous police report pose problems for Matlock when he agrees to defend a psychiatrist, Lucas Forbes.

The brutal murder of an ambitious, beauty contest hopeful taints the annual Reach for the Stars ceremonies. Matlock is reunited with an old girlfriend, Janet Masters, whose daughter, Morgan, is accused of the crime.
Matlock defends a prominent psychic, Jennifer Holtz, who foresees her boyfriend’s murder and is subsequently arrested when he is found dead and Jennifer has no alibi.

A rare-coin dealer invests his trust in Matlock when he’s accused of murdering an employee who was caught stealing valuable coins. Meanwhile, Tyler becomes disgruntled when Matlock hires another private investigator, Linda Hansfield, to work on the case.
While defending a coin dealer accused of murdering an employee, Matlock and Tyler suspect the new investigator Ben hired, Linda Hansfield, is being blackmailed by the real killer.
A picturesque thoroughbred horse farm provides an unusual setting for murder when Ben Matlock defends a slow-witted stable hand, Tommy Jenks, accused of killing the stable owner’s daughter.

Ben Matlock defends a renowned journalist accused of murdering a beautiful international model. Matlock’s investigation is stalled when he is struck by a car and lands in the hospital with a slight case of amnesia.

Matlock believes in the innocence of a man whose brainwashed son insists he saw his father kill the leader of his cult. Ben is the only hope left for a concerned father whose son, David, has been swept into a religious cult.
A legendary blues guitarist is singing the blues when he’s charged with the murder of a rock star who promised to write him a hit song.
A lawyer friend of Matlock’s puts his faith in the crafty attorney when his client is accused of killing a feisty priest, Father Fitzgerald.
Ben Matlock gives his assistant, Michelle Thomas, her toughest courtroom assignment... breaking down the eyewitness testimony of a former law classmate in a brutal murder case.
District Attorney Julie March matches wits with tempestuous author Cynthia Slayton, whose torrid novels are suddenly eclipsed by facts surrounding the death of her best friend.
The serenity of historic Roanoke Island is shattered when a retired career soldier attempts to prove his late brother’s death was not a hunting accident, but murder.
The IMF foils the attempts of a once-powerful communist to regain power.
The IMF goes to the aid of a friendly South American government which has been overthrown by revolutionaries.
The IMF takes the task of recovering a secret fail-safe device.
Cinnamon poses as a 50-year-old blind princess, heiress to a Balkan kingdom.
The Impossible Missions Force is assigned to knock out a boxing syndicate which fixes fights to create favorable odds for a bookmaking operation, in the first half of a two-part story.
Barney poses as a fighter making his comeback, who boxes his way to a title bout with Staczek (Robert Phillips) in the second half of a two-part episode.

The Impossible Missions Force, led by Jim Phelps (Peter Graves) enters Equatorial Africa to crush an army of mercenaries, led by a self-styled colonel, and to return plundered gold to its rightful owners.
Not knowing when, where, or how a dangerous adversary will strike, Jim Phelps and Cinnamon use themselves as human quarries.
An army commander (played by guest star Theodore Bikel) plots to become dictator by imprisoning an influential cardinal and using a look-alike actor for a public endorsement.
The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.
Guest star Fernando Lamas portrays a diplomat-playboy who romances another diplomat's wife, played by Lee Grant.
With Phelps and Rollin as the leading men, the Impossible Missions Force stages an anti-American play which could prove to be a strong propaganda device for the enemy.
The former dictator of a Caribbean island is made to have hallucinatory visions in which he sees his ominous destiny as part of an ingenious plot designed by the Impossible Missions Force.

Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.
Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.

The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.

Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely look at snow globes and see a film about how people make cereal. King Friday says he is the bravest and strongest in the neighborhood. Cereal is falling like snow. Mister Rogers goes to a Tae Kwon Do class.

Mister Rogers returns a scarf to one of Mr. Brewer's puppets which makes the puppet feel brave and strong. Elsie Jean Platypus tells Lady Abelrin that the cereal quit falling on her because she was not afraid of it.

Mister Rogers visits the McFeelys, who are watching after young lambs. Handyman Negri and King Friday put on full cereal-proof armor. When their efforts fail, it is clear that Daniel is the only one who can stop the cereal from falling.

Mister Rogers demonstrates how to use tuning whistles. Daniel has the idea to give the cereal to people who might need food. Neighbor Aber brings a forklift to gather all the boxes. Mr. McFeely brings a video about how people make it.
Mister Rogers remembers a time when he visited Jay Styperk, a para-Olympic swimmer. King Friday's crown has gone missing. He hesitantly enters the castle garden, wearing his swimming cap and goggles.

programmes.st: Making a Sculpture with Found Objects
programmes.d: Mister Rogers uses objects from his kitchen to make a horse sculpture. Prince Tuesday is dressed in a lion costume and startles Mayor Maggie. He explains that wearing the costume helps him feel brave about looking for his father's crown.
Mr. McFeely delivers a video about how people make apple juice. King Friday suggests that Lady Aberlin start looking for his missing crown at the Museum-Go-Round.

Mister Rogers arrives with a fish sculpted from the paper by his friend Ben Gonzales.  Edgar Cooke shares with Lady Aberlin that his refrigerator and food are gone. She finds it, along with King Friday's crown and the Westwood sign.

Bill Nye, “the Science Guy” stops by to show a science experiment using baking soda and vinegar to blow up a balloon. Mister Rogers shows a video of dump trucks at a construction site, and in Make-Believe, all that was lost is found.

programmes.st: Be Yourself: Visit with David Copperfield
programmes.d: Magician David Copperfield teaches Mister Rogers how to do a magic trick. It takes lots of practice. In Make-Believe, X is giving flying lessons, and there's a video of what the world looks like from a bird's point of view.

programmes.st: Visit with the Uptown String Quartet
programmes.d: Prince Tuesday is upset about being unable to fly, so Lady Elaine gives him a propeller hat. He jumps off the castle wall, thinking the hat will make him fly, and injures his arm. Mister Rogers visits the Uptown String Quartet.

X says he is feeling guilty about Prince Tuesday's fall. Neighbor Aber says it was not X's flying lessons that made Prince Tuesday get hurt. Mister Rogers shows a video about people making sleeping bags. He visits the workshop of the doll maker.

programmes.st: Feeling Good About Who We Are
programmes.d: Hula-hoop expert Paul Tifford gives Mister Rogers some lessons. It takes a lot of practice to be able to use a hula-hoop well, and falling and getting up again are a part of learning!

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Puts on a Vest!
programmes.d: Instead of changing into a sweater as he typically does, Mister Rogers puts on a vest made by his friend Saihou Njie. Trolley brings a batik cloth to Handyman Negri, who then gives it to King Friday.

Mister Rogers arrives with a children's plastic potty, takes it to his bathroom and compares it to the adult-sized toilet. Prince Tuesday comes up with a game using a bucket but has had his feelings hurt when his father was not impressed.

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

programmes.st: Field Trip to Visit Koko the Gorilla
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

programmes.st: An Eye Exam for Mister Rogers
programmes.d: At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

programmes.st: A Boy and His Service Dog
programmes.d: Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Rides In a Helicopter
programmes.d: Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

programmes.st: Musician Yo-Yo Ma and Inventor Chuck Hoberman
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of inventor Chuck Hoberman with his sphere and a video of Yo-Yo and Nicholas Ma. The neighbors are waiting for Bob Dog's helicopter to land. They discover that the helicopter responds to guitar music.

Mister Rogers visits Maya Lin at her studio to see how she first makes small models of big things she is working on. They go to Penn Station to see what she created there. In Make-Believe, there's a video visit with cellist Yo-Yo Ma.

Mister Rogers sees a performance by the Westminster Bell Choir and shows how people make bells. Mayor Maggie has a bell that she plays with King Friday and gives to Henrietta as a doorbell. Daniel and H.J. Elephant dress up as astronauts.

Visiting a nearby dance studio, Mister Rogers watches a class of young students learning to use ribbons as part of their dance routine. Henrietta is still ringing her new bell and X the Owl is growing quite frustrated.

Percussionist Tim Adams performs. H.J. Elephant is dressed in his outerspace costume as he tells Lady Aberlin about pretending to fly to the moon. He makes a loud trumpet sound which causes alarm for X and Henrietta.

Mister Rogers shows a video of himself and Sylvia Earle snorkeling in the ocean. Lady Elaine says she is hiding from something they are afraid of from outer space. Mister Rogers suggests when something is scary on TV,  turn it off.

In the series premiere, the Major Crimes department is still reeling with the newly appointed head of the unit, Captain Sharon Raydor (series star Mary McDonnell).
There are growing pains within Major Crimes as the division works to obtain justice in a brutal homicide. The changes within the department may be more than Provenza can accept.
Director Shepard takes a huge risk and agrees to meet an informant alone about Le Grenouille, but the meeting goes bad and her contact is killed.
Gibbs and the team investigate when a blind photographer inadvertently captures the murder of a petty officer on file.

Gibbs ignores the bureaucratic paperwork associated with his "acting" director duties and leads an investigation for a murder victim found in a taxi headed to NCIS headquarters. Meanwhile, Jenny discovers a secret about her past.
As the NCIS Director returns from a controversial European junket, and Gibbs and his agents reluctantly prepare for Homeland Security polygraph tests, tightly woven secrets among the team unravel.
The coordinated attack on the Duttons continues, as everyone searches for answers on who is responsible. Rip delivers on a promise.
The Yellowstone recovers and begins planning revenge. Rainwater receives an offer from a newcomer. Rip gets a surprise.

programmes.d: John seeks revenge with help from some unexpected allies. Kayce solves a problem with an unconventional method. Beth gives Carter his options. Jimmy prepares for a change.
Jamie receives some surprising news, and Beth receives an offer. Jimmy settles in on the road. Tensions boil over in the bunkhouse.

programmes.st: Yellowstone Under A Blanket of Red
programmes.d: John and Kayce are forced to deal with some newcomers in town. Lloyd is in the doghouse with Rip, and finds purpose in teaching Carter. Jamie seeks information about his father.

programmes.d: Beth confronts her father's houseguest. Kayce and his family search for a new home. Jamie seeks answers from Garrett. Lloyd loses his cool.
John is put in an awkward position by Governor Perry. Carter works to earn back Beth's trust. Jamie is in for a big surprise.

programmes.st: Yellowstone No Kindness for the Coward
programmes.d: Tensions escalate with the protestors, but Beth has a plan. Jimmy and Emily get closer. Monica and Kayce share a special moment.

programmes.st: Yellowstone No Such Thing as Fair
programmes.d: John and Beth squabble. Cowboy School is over for Jimmy, who has an important decision to make. Kayce begins a new quest. Jamie realizes Garrett's past might affect his own future.

programmes.st: Yellowstone Grass on the Streets and Weeds on the Rooftops
programmes.d: To the Duttons, family is everything. But newfound truths threaten that bond. Jimmy comes home, and has important decisions to make. Beth takes family matters into her own hands.
Adam and Andi toy with having another baby when Don and Marcy's newborn grandson comes for a visit.
Andi hires a pretty, young babysitter, Sophia (Victoria Justice), to watch the kids, and gets jealous when her daughter, Kate, goes to her instead for advice.
When Adam discovers that the pastor he hired for their wedding was a phony and he and Andi aren't really married, he scrambles to find a way to fix it before she finds out.
When the kids won't do their chores, Adam and Andi decide to go on strike too.

programmes.d: Charlie has to find creative ways to entertain the 4-year-old son of his girlfriend, Linda (recurring guest star Ming Wen). Meanwhile, Alan becomes a human "guinea pig."
Charlie's girlfriend, Linda (recurring guest star Ming Wen), is embarrassed to be seen in public with him. Meanwhile, despite Alan forbidding it, Jake sneaks out to a concert.

programmes.st: Our Leather Gear Is in the Guest Room
programmes.d: Charlie and Alan argue over Alan's place in the house, prompting Alan and Jake to move in with Evelyn. Recurring guest star Robert Wagner appears as Teddy, Evelyn's boyfriend.
Charlie finds success as a children's singing star, making Alan miserable. Guest star Richard Kind appears as Artie, an executive at Charlie's record label.
Dave is forced to apologize for his comments in a magazine interview.
The NewsRadio crew faces disaster on a space station hundreds of years in the future.
Matthew is asked to lie about an accident at work.
On his first day as WNYX's News Director, Dave finds that he must first fire his predecessor.
Maya gets the magazine in trouble with her honest appraisal of a famous fashion designer's new work.
Maya is roped into a blind date by Nina, only to discover that it's with a philandering congressman.
Maya and her colleagues recall the circumstances which led to their being hired by Jack.
Elliott promises to get revenge after Finch is taken advantage of by a woman.

There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free-spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York.  Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.
The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.
When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.
Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.
Doug and Carrie hire Steve and his group of Russian mold employees to repair their damage, but it takes much longer and costs more than they expected.
On Valentine's Day, Carrie has to cancel dinner with Doug because he and Deacon have to deliver 2 penguins to Albany.
Doug and Carrie pick up some of their photos, but soon they find out, it's not their photos, but photos of another couple.
Doug doesn't want to go to the opera.

programmes.d: Convinced that Alan's family doesn't fully appreciate him, Melissa (guest star KELLY STABLES) invites Alan to live with her and her mom (guest star CAROL KANE).

programmes.d: Charlie has to remove a half-naked woman (guest star DIORA BAIRD) from his bedroom before Chelsea (guest star JENNIFER TAYLOR) arrives.
Charlie tells Chelsea (guest star JENNIFER TAYLOR) that he loves her, but doesn't get the response he expects.
When Chelsea gets sick and Charlie has to take care of her, he must also fight the overwhelming urge to flee.  MARTIN MULL reprises his role as Charlie's pharmacist, Russell.
Charlie joins Alan, Herb and his neighbor (MICHAEL CLARKE DUNCAN) in a night of alcohol-fueled sexual reminiscences after Chelsea finds nude pictures of another woman on his phone.
Becker runs into an old flame and fights with his conscience to spend the night with her because she's a married woman. (TV-PG)

Margaret has an erotic dream about John and Linda tries to analyze it. Reggie, Jake and Bob get drunk off a keg of beer. (TV-PG)
Story of the Old West's most murderous villains, including the James Younger gang, the first real bank robbers in America; the Dalton Brothers; and, Butch Cassidy's Wild Bunch.
A mother is found shot in her car with no witnesses. A son kills his veteran father, claiming self-defense.
A man calls the police after an attack; phone data tracks the killer. A dog lover is found murdered at home.
A mysterious meeting ends with a woman's body found on a country lane. A mother is dead after a house fire.

Murders are rare in tranquil Delta Township, Michigan. So when a well-liked couple is gunned down in their home, residents are terrified--until police discover the monster accidentally left a trail of breadcrumbs leading right to his door.

programmes.st: Faith And Foul Play In Salt Lake City
programmes.d: Police investigate the bomb that blew apart the car of Mark Hoffmann, a highly respected and religious Mormon. Narrated by Paul Winfield.
A conservative town with strong law-and-order values is shaken up when its tough county judge is charged with killing his political rival's law partner.

When a mother of two is brutally murdered, her family becomes convinced that her husband, a shady lawyer, is responsible. But many in Atlanta cannot believe that the former prosecutor and part-time judge is involved.

programmes.st: Sunny Days, Deadly Nights On Mercer Island
programmes.d: A woman's naked body is found outside a Seattle nightclub, posed demurely with a pinecone in her hand. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

A serial rapist targeted women.  His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder.  He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime.  After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area.  They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.
In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States.  Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

The average bank robbery yields roughly 3,000 dollars.   Yet some criminals risk everything for the take.  In suburban Chicago, a disguised gunman began a series of robberies, growing more violent with each one.
A child's murder in 1990s Rockhampton leads to the arrest of Leonard Fraser, linking him to other disappearances.
Handyman Morris Solomon terrorized Sacramento in the 1980s, leaving a trail of victims before his capture and death sentence.
Eight sex workers vanished in NY over two years. In Sept. 1998, a victim named Kendall Francois led police to find eight bodies in his home.

programmes.d: The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!
A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!

programmes.st: The guy who's the closest to invincible? And the most dangerous man!
programmes.d: Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard Captain Foxy’s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse awaits them!

programmes.st: Navy headquarters admiral aokiji! The ferocity of an ultimate powerhouse!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!

programmes.st: Duel between rubber and ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
programmes.d: Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!

programmes.st: The dashing sea train and the city of water, water seven!
programmes.d: An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!

programmes.st: Adventure in the city on the water! Head to the mammoth shipbuilding plant!
programmes.d: Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separated during their quest to find a bookstore!
Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!

programmes.st: Galley-la company! A grand sight: dock #1!
programmes.d: A carpenter and his talking pigeon help recover the Straw Hats’ missing money, but the Franky Family won’t give up so easily. Luffy and Nami receive very bad news about their beloved boat!

programmes.st: Pirate abduction incident! A pirate ship that can only await her end!
programmes.d: Luffy and Nami refuse to believe that the Going Merry’s seaworthy days are finished, but for now, bigger problems loom on the horizon! Their money is missing again, along with Usopp!

programmes.st: Rescuing our friend! Raid on the franky house!
programmes.d: Usopp bravely tries to recover the stolen money, but the Franky Family has him badly outnumbered. Zoro, Sanji, and Chopper set out on a rescue mission, but they’ll need Luffy to even the odds!

programmes.st: Big fight under the moon! The pirate flag flutters with sorrow!
programmes.d: Usopp regains consciousness after his vicious beating, but he’s not at all happy to hear Luffy’s plans for the Going Merry. Temper flares and challenges are issued as the Straw Hats face their most uncertain hour.

programmes.st: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of two men's pride!
programmes.d: Luffy and Usopp battle to a brutal standstill in a heartbreaking duel between men who once called each other family. Can the Straw Hats find the strength to carry on without their sniper?

programmes.st: Severe shock hits the city of water! Iceberg targeted!
programmes.d: The Straw Hat split is overshadowed by an assassination attempt on the mayor of Water Seven! Luffy is eager to investigate, but the leader of the Franky Family is about to reappear!
Luffy’s grudge match with Franky gets serious when his opponent turns out to be a cyborg! Iceberg awakes from his slumber only to hurl heinous accusations at the Straw Hats!

programmes.st: The straw hat pirates are the culprits? The protectors of the city of water!
programmes.d: Luffy is branded an assassin and attacked by Iceberg’s strongest men! Meanwhile, Sanji and Chopper attempt to warn Usopp about an impending natural disaster!

programmes.st: Eternal farewell? Nico robin: the woman who draws darkness!
programmes.d: The citizens of Water Seven search for the Straw Hats and a devastating storm threatens to sink the city. Chopper and Sanji pick up Robin’s trail, but they aren’t prepared for what they’ll find.

programmes.st: Capture robin! The determination of the straw hats!
programmes.d: Usopp prepares to ride out the storm aboard the Going Merry, Franky hatches a plan to force Luffy into a rematch, and the Straw Hats set out to uncover Robin’s dark secret.

programmes.st: Cannon fire is the signal! Cp9 goes into action!
programmes.d: Robin and her CP9 brethren seek to settle unfinished business with Iceberg. The Straw Hats have a plan to clear their names, but the assassins are one step ahead of them.

programmes.st: Cp9 takes off their masks! Their shocking true faces!
programmes.d: Luffy makes his long-awaited entrance, Iceberg has a shocking surprise in store for Robin, and the true identities of the masked assassins of CP9 are finally revealed!
CP9 listens to Iceberg’s blood to learn the location of the blueprints, Usopp has another run-in with Franky and the remaining Straw Hats – plus a new friend – race to the rescue!

programmes.st: Come back, Robin! Showdown with cp9!
programmes.d: Luffy and the gang come face to face with Robin and her CP9 comrades. The rubberman is prepared to fight for his friend, but he’s never faced foes like this!

programmes.st: The straw hat pirates annihilated? The menace of the leopard model!
programmes.d: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami are sent hurtling toward their deaths by the villains of CP9! Meanwhile, Usopp forges an unlikely friendship with Franky while waiting out a storm.

programmes.st: The man who is loved even by his ship! Usopp's tears!
programmes.d: Franky tries to convince Usopp that there’s no hope for the Going Merry, but the sniper – inspired by a mysterious moment from the past – remains loyal to his beloved boat

Twin sisters, raised with a deep disdain for law enforcement, are arrested for shooting a neighbor's dog, then escape custody and go on the run, leading to one of the deadliest shootouts in Colorado history.

Raised in a strict home, Matthew and Tyler believe it's their duty to cleanse the world of those living in sin; when two men are found dead, the brother's connection to them points toward a hateful trail of crime.

Sheltered teenage brothers Robert and Michael Bever idolize serial killers and dream of being the most prolific murderers in history; with an arsenal of weapons, their quest for notoriety begins at home in their quiet Oklahoma suburb.

The Carr brothers arrive in Wichita, Kan., intending to commit robberies, but their plans quickly escalate to a murderous spree the likes of which Kansas had never seen; their reign of terror becomes known as the "Wichita Massacre."

After a man is found brutally murdered inside his own bar, a murder mystery unfolds over the span of years; detectives believe it's a business deal gone bad and must remain steadfastly dedicated to the case after hitting several dead ends.
In the summer of 1991, a pair of half-siblings creates panic across southern California when they embark on a spree of random crimes of the worst kind, targeting people out doing everyday tasks.

Over a brutal 7-month stretch, a trio of brothers commit a series of increasingly violent crimes across the city of Richmond, leaving behind a growing body count; even after their apprehension, these brothers prove difficult to contain.

A pair of larger-than-life identical twins commit a series of brutal attacks in a small Tennessee town; with each crime, the brothers grow more emboldened; as time goes on and with little evidence against them, there's no telling how far they'll go.

When a correctional officer is murdered, it seems like an act of vengeance, but a love triangle is exposed; after learning his wife is having an affair, a husband plans to kill her lover and enlists the help of his brothers to carry out the task.

A missing persons case spirals down a winding path once detectives learn that a formerly beloved older brother appears to have embezzled money from the family's business; his siblings are hellbent on getting revenge.

In one of the most tragic and brutal crimes in the history of the Great Plains, five teens playing by a campfire are ambushed by a trio of shotgun-wielding brothers; a lone survivor bravely helps detectives hunt down her assailants.
An immigrant family's American dream turns into a nightmare when a devious sister manipulates her younger valedictorian brother into committing murder; a dark family secret comes to light.
In this bizarre Midwestern saga; a grudge between a shady district attorney and an eccentric local student turns deadly; investigators work for decades to bring a quartet of brothers to justice.

When a body is found badly burned outside of Chicago, police work tirelessly to track down the killer of this young, hardworking truck driver; the search leads them to an unlikely pair of teenage sisters who are able to evade capture for years.
When the patrons of a rural bar are murdered execution-style, two determined detectives work to track down a pair of killer brothers and solve the most heinous crime in the history of the small town.

Two brothers pull off an elaborate scheme in the desert to rob an armored van of $300,000; when investigators attempt to track down the illusive robbers, the case becomes a homicide once the bodies of the two guards driving the van turn up.
In the fall of 1992, two brothers terrorize a California community when they embark on a two-month crime spree that includes three brutal murders and many more near-death attacks.

Residents of quiet Noel, Mo., are shocked when the local bank is robbed in a brazen nighttime heist; the investigation takes a sinister turn when the bank's president is found dead and a pair of brothers suddenly come into a lot of cash.

Things get murky along the Tennessee River when a mussel distributor and his fiancée are killed by a trio of roughneck brothers who are determined to steal a big payout and silence anyone who gets in their way.

The ambitious Luna brothers take wildly divergent paths, one becoming a decorated army officer while another rises in a Mexican cartel; when the brothers' worlds collide, a murder ultimately brings them down.

Lavon organizes a BlueBell talent show. But when Shelby (Laura Bell Bundy) suddenly becomes ill before her performance, it is a mystery the entire town tries to solve.
To keep Zoe from getting stressed, Wade lies to her about how great the Rammer Jammer is doing. Lemon and Lavon try to move on with their lives, but it's easier said than done.
Zoe and Wade learn the gender of their baby and realize that they are not ready for parenthood. Lavon must talk to his nemesis over in Fillmore, but he needs AnnaBeth's help.
Zoe is upset after seeing Wade flirting. Wade turns to Lavon for guidance, but soon finds himself in even worse trouble. George and AnnaBeth try to make their own new adventures.
Brick thinks Lavon and Wade are leading him to a surprise party for his birthday, but they have really invited him to go fishing. Lemon and Zoe make plans to have a girls' day.
The town panics after AnnaBeth is visited in a dream by BlueBell's founder, who prophesies five omens about the end of BlueBell. George gets a potentially life-changing offer.
In the season finale, Zoe makes a life-changing decision and Wade does his best to make it happen before their baby is born. Lavon determines to make things right with Lemon.
Rachel Bilson stars in this fish-out-of-water series about a New York City doctor adjusting to life in a small southern town.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programmes.d: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programmes.d: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programmes.d: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.
Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programmes.d: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.
Those ghastly ghosts return to battle once more with JoBeth Williams and Craig T. Nelson for the soul of a young clairvoyant.
Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!
A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.
After arriving at New York's JFK airport, Viktor Navorski gets unwittingly caught in bureaucratic glitches that make it impossible for him to return to his home country or enter the U.S.

Hailed as a landmark film that dazzles with deep emotion and exceptional acting, PHILADELPHIA stars Tom Hanks and Denzel Washington as two competing lawyers who join forces to sue a prestigious law firm for AIDS discrimination. Rating: PG-13

A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.
Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.
Even with many leads, including an insulin overdose, a tooth infection, and chronic lupus, the pieces don’t add up in the case of a woman's death. Will Dr. G be able to uncover the truth?
A British hiker spends 10 days stranded in the mountains of New Zealand following a crippling fall.
In June 1996, a group of 5 teenage scouts and 3 adult guides hiked into the Grand Canyon during a heatwave; the route was an off-trail route in the vicinity of the Nankoweap Trail.
Divorcee Mathew  McGough is taking  his five-year-old daughter Shannon for an overnight camping  trip.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Stabbed In The Heart
programmes.d: A stabbing victim's heart has a hole in it, and must be pumped by hand to keep him alive; a woman believes that she is possessed by demons; a man with a vibrator in his rectum offers to pay cash to keep his condition off of his medical record.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Mountain Lion Attack
programmes.d: After barely survivi+D4:D21cang an attack by a mountain lion, a woman is airlifted to hospital. Doctors have never seen anything so brutal and disfiguring.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Say Your Prayers
programmes.d: A man is bitten by a deadly rattlesnake, but because of religious reasons cannot receive a blood transfusion. Will he survive?

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Baby Blues
programmes.d: Real-life stories of medical emergencies. Follow the case of a boy with an oxygen deficiency and bizarre brown blood. Meanwhile, a man has his arm stuck in a meat grinder, and he's losing blood.
A harrowing cold case into the murder of a young woman is finally solved when officers retrieve a discarded coffee cup from a casino garbage bin.
Police are unaware a murder has been committed until someone uses the information to try and leverage their freedom.
The story of Malcolm Green, who was jailed for life for the brutal murder of a Cardiff prostitute, only to kill again when he was released after 18 years.
For one week in 2016, Stefano Brizzi stored the body of a policeman in his flat in central London. Taking inspiration from the TV show Breaking Bad, he tried to dissolve the body in his bath tub.
Two-time adventure racing world champion Danelle Ballengee suffers a pelvis-shattering 60-foot fall.
In 2003, David Hunt and his daughter Leia, set off on a snowmobiling adventure in the Quebec backcountry.

In August 2002, a young man and woman, once dating, headed for the Amazon rain forest but got lost in the jungle. They have to survive the dangers of the jungle and hold on to their sanity as they find their way home.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Director Down
programmes.d: A ruptured brain aneurysm threatens to kill the ER's medical director, making Dr. Yamarick face one of his most difficult moments.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Stuck In A Toilet
programmes.d: A woman is stuck for over 18 hours in a toilet bowl;  doctors struggle to save the life of a man who's been mangled by a stump grinder; when a nurse collapses in the hospital, doctors and staff make a shocking discovery.

programmes.st: The Battle of Berlin: Death of a City
programmes.d: The final push in WWII and German resistance in Berlin finally capitulates.

Counterstrike can take many forms and history is full of examples where a numerically inferior army has turned the tide of battle by a brilliant execution of a Counterstrike. Discover three historical examples of successful counterstrike’s.

The Battleplan for Blockade is directed not against an army or navy, or an individual town or city, but against a nation as a whole. Learn how blockades have the ability to destroy or at least damage a country’s ability to wage war.

programmes.t: United States Military: A History Of...
programmes.st: United States Military: A History Of Heroes
programmes.d: The origins and creation of our nation's stopgap military force from 1775 - 1916

programmes.t: United States Military: A History Of...
programmes.st: United States Military: A History Of Heroes
programmes.d: The colorful history and evolution of the men and women of our nation's Marine Corps from 1917 to today

programmes.t: United States Military: A History Of...
programmes.st: United States Military: A History Of Heroes
programmes.d: The evolution of our nation's superiority in the skies, from 1903 to today.

programmes.t: United States Military: A History Of...
programmes.st: United States Military: A History Of Heroes
programmes.d: The proud history and traditions of the soldiers who stood against our nations enemies to defended our freedoms, from 1775 to 1899
When Germany began Europe’s WWII by invading Poland in 1939, China had already been fighting Imperial Japan for two years. Lasted from 1937-45 it cost 14 million Chinese lives.

By 1942, the Japanese Empire stretched halfway across the Pacific Ocean. This is the rarely told story of the key role played by US Marine tanks in the Pacific Campaign. They fight bloody battles against fanatical Japanese forces.

Greatest Tank Battles is an action-packed 10-part series that brings to life the most gripping and monumental tank battles ever fought ... filmed on battlefields across the world, and using stunning, ultra-realistic CGI animation and eyewitness accounts.

programmes.st: The October War: Battle for the Golan Heights
programmes.d: In 1973, Syria launches a surprise attack against Israel in the Golan Heights. This is a story of survival, where a few out-numbered tankers manage to hold off an enemy of overwhelming size in one of the greatest tank battles ever waged.

In 1942, Rommel’s Desert Afrika Corps faces off against Montgomery’s Eighth Army. This is the story of the climax in the struggle for North Africa, which would change the course of the Second World War.

Hosted by Gary Sinise, The Real American showcases five stories of American heroes who risked their lives in dedication to their country. From Pearl Harbor, to 9-11 and through Afghanistan, all tied together by one man officers dubbed, The Real American.
The first major battle of the war takes place at Ia Drang. Colonel Hal Moore leads the 1st Cavalry Division against hardened North Vietnamese regulars.
A runaway bride makes herself scarce at a winter resort, where she meets a charming ski patrol rescuer. Just when she begins to believe in love again, her jilted fiance arrives at the resort.
This Christmas three women plot revenge on the guy who cruelly dumped them all. But will vengence be worth risking a chance at new love?
A sous chef begins doubting her future with her boyfriend after a handsome maple farmer comes to her rescue.
Celebrity chef Josie returns home to craft a holiday menu for her mom's new restaurant and clashes with visiting food critic Tanner—sparks may fly before Christmas.
Christmas chaos, secrets, and mishaps as two sisters team up to throw the holiday party of the year.
Two news broadcasters who previously were in love, fight for a position as a morning talk show host that they both want, ultimately finding what made them like each other so much in the first place.
High-powered event planner Hayley expects a quiet mountain Christmas with family—until she learns Paul, her ex’s meddling friend, will be there too. As sparks fly, she begins falling for him instead.
A young woman who comes from a life of privilege falls for the owner of a soup kitchen after discovering a Dear Santa letter written by his seven year old daughter.

During the holidays, a struggling mother and her daughter pose as the family of her bachelor boss (Eric McCormack, ?Will & Grace?) to help him impress a tradition-minded industrialist interested in acquiring the company.

Angelina Balistreri believes her home is haunted by a harmless ghost, while her husband, Emiliano, is skeptical of the paranormal. They call in a priest and medium who makes contact with a troubled ghost and helps him cross over and find peace.
The Fahey family has lived in the same townhouse in the city of Galway, Ireland, for decades. But when a new baby arrives, he stirs up the psychic energy of a terrible crime committed many years ago.

When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

Bobby and Addie Wilcott buy an historic house in New England. When their 5-year-old son is attacked by an unseen entity, paranormal experts discover a demonic presence. Their only hope is an exorcism.

Candace and John St. Clair explore a haunted tunnel with a gruesome history where slaves were buried alive. Stealthily, an uninvited guest follows them home. Attacked by the entity, they invite paranormal experts to investigate and cleanse the home.

Professor Mark Spencer and his wife Rebecca have just purchased the historic Allen House in Arkansas. Shortly after moving in, Rebecca comes face to face with a faceless spirit. Mark calls investigators to determine if the spirit means them harm.
Since childhood, Rebecca has been able to see and hear spirits but has blocked out their attempts to communicate. But after her marriage with Daniel, a ghost emerges who refuses to be ignored.

Jennifer Hoke's family found their dream home along the waterfront in Florida; little do they know something dark is lurking in their dream house. What starts as strange noises escalates to physical attacks.
Following the breakup of his marriage, Steven LaChance begins to experience strange things inside his house, and comes to believe that disembodied spirits are preying on his children.
Soon after Randy recites an incantation from a book on witchcraft, hoping to make contact with spirits of the dead, a growling monster appears and tries to strangle his loved ones
Eddie Benitez fears that the spirit of a dead man who committed suicide is slowly killing his son. He turns to his Puerto Rican roots to combat the deadly ghost and save his family.
Stacy Jones has dedicated her life to helping others understand and cope with paranormal threats. When she witnesses a demon attacking her son, she enlists her colleague John Zaffis to save her son.
Romie feels drawn to the abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona, that becomes her future home. After she moves in, Romie begins to have nightmares and she sees a shadowy spirit pacing in her hallway.

After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits – one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

After moving in their dream home, Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero begin to experience strange occurrences; mysterious footsteps and unexplained noises. Lillian is physically attacked while sleeping and the couple tries to escape, but is it too late?

After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

When Dennis Pongratz finds his deceased father's Army belongings, he unlocks a treasure trove of WWII memorabilia, including an armband removed from a Nazi soldier killed in battle. Soon the Pongratz home becomes a battleground between good and evil.
A sexy and unpredictable single mother of two is a source of constant embarrassment to her confused 15-year-old daughter, who's trying to deal with her own sexual awakening.
A bored New Jersey suburban housewife's fascination with a kooky character she's read about in the personal columns leads to her being mistaken for the woman herself.

Jenny is instantly smitten when she meets her new roommate, Shane’s current love interest, Carmen.  Carmen is both dejected and intrigued by Shane’s inability to open up, but is also attracted to Jenny.

Bette travels to New York for some damage control with Helena Peabody, the new administrator of a foundation that provides financial support to the Art Center. Shane and Jenny interview prospective roommates but can’t quite find the perfect candidate.
Jenny and Shane's new roommate secretly tapes them.
Tina moves out; Alice gives Dana an ultimatum.
Alice and Dana tentatively begin dating, while Tina comes between Helena and her ex. Bette rejoins the singles scene, and Shane dulls her pain over Jenny and Carmen.
Bette and Tina agree to forge a new relationship. Jenny loses a chance to ghost-write a macho TV star's autobiography because she's gay.
Alice's sex-toy request freaks out Dana. Jenny learns the truth about TV star Burr, and about Carmen's feelings for Shane.
A lesbian cruise in the Caribbean proves eventful for Dana, Alice, Shane, Jenny and Carmen, while Bette and Kit struggle to connect with their aging father Melvin during a visit.
Against the backdrop of a gay-pride parade, shocking secrets are revealed about Dana's brother and Jenny's past, while Bette and Kit deal with their rapidly deteriorating father.

Bette moves her father, played by Emmy-nominated actor Ossie Davis, into her home for his final days. Alice struggles with her jealousy over Dana's dinner with an ex, and Jenny flirts with danger while confronting a repressed memory.

Melvin's memorial service is attended by a surprise guest. Bette is fired by Franklin, then coaches Tina through what turns out to be an unexpectedly difficult labor and delivery. Jenny is in trouble and asks for help.

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.
The "Universal Soldiers" must fight the entire army when the military's supercomputer, S.E.T.H., gets out of control.
The Wachowski Brothers bring a classic anime to the big screen: Matthew Fox, John Goodman, Christina Ricci, and Susan Sarandon star with Emile Hirsch as Speed Racer!

When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.

The highly anticipated opening of a New York Wahlburgers in Coney Island is stuck in last minute delays.  Not wanting to postpone the event, Donnie, Mark and Paul move forward with a public celebration all over the famous amusement park while battling.

Mark's friends are constantly looking to him for advice so when "Big A" lands a date of course he turns to Mark. Using some high tech audio gear, Mark is able to feed "Big A" lines during his lunch date. Back at Wahlburgers, Paul is stumped for a burger.
When Johnny Drama looks to take his music career to the next level, Mark suggests Drama make a music video that Mark himself will direct.

Mark flies to Philadelphia to host The Festival of Families to honor Pope Francis where Mark performs the emcee gig of a lifetime. Meanwhile, Alma, Paul and Bob attend the annual Wahlberg family reunion where Brandon gets his first chance to join poker.

Donnie promises to bring Wahlburgers to his Blue Bloods co-star Marisa Ramirez and the rest of the cast and crew.  Unfortunately, Mark sent Paul to Costa Rica for a much needed vacation.  Alma employs Brandon to help Donnie save face in front of his Blue.
Whenever New Kids on the Block perform in their hometown of Boston, it is a family event.

On a movie promotional tour in France, Mark invites Paul to Paris so the two of them can do some sightseeing as well as be together for Mark's birthday dinner. Of course, Mark also wants Paul to cook for him and his French-speaking actor friend.
Jeff gambles on a series of end-of-the-line deals in hopes of a big payday.
Jeff falls hard for a vintage motorbike. Then when things go wrong with a mechanic, he has to turn to Sheldon the Bailiff to get it back.
Jeff and Daniel travel to the California desert to visit an abandoned town, meet slot machine collectors, and make a deal on 30,000 wine corks.
Jeff makes a deal for fur coats and risks his reputation on a Hollywood memorabilia auction.

In Florida, tempers flare during a flight's deboarding process as an impulsive passenger attempts to force his way down the aisle. In New Jersey, a mall-goer's unique outlook on life stuns the man interviewing him.
In this top ten special of Customer Wars, irate patrons received poor service and they're not afraid to shout about it.
On this top ten special of Customer Wars, patience is a virtue. And it's something all these customers are running out of.
See what happens when customers help themselves to anything...they...want, in this top ten episode of Customer Wars.
Customer satisfaction isn't always guaranteed in this top ten episode of Customer Wars, especially if there are fists involved.
A woman vandalizes a New Jersey convenience store by randomly sweeping items off the shelves. A rideshare driver in Florida is pushed to the brink by a rude and unsanitary rider.
COO of Churchill Downs, Bill Carstanjan, faces his fear of horses head-on to go undercover in his own company.
Michael Rubin, one of America's youngest CEOs, goes undercover in the billion-dollar e-commerce company that he founded.
Joel Manby, a boss who recently turned his life around, goes undercover in his nationwide theme park and amusement company.

Paul and Bogart swore never to bring Bogart's sisters to another auction, which is why Roy brings them to one in Cambridge. Rick and Cindy try getting lucky with some models, while Ursula hopes magician Zack Mirza can make money materialize.

programmes.st: Roy Dimbeck: The Roy Dimbeck Story
programmes.d: After months of waiting for Cindy to set a wedding date, Rick makes a bold move at an auction in Mississauga. Roy records his memoirs for bidding posterity. Ursula finds a new place to stash her booze, and Paul and Bogart get conched on the head.

Roy antagonizes the buyers at an auction in Don Mills with free psychological analysis. Ursula tries to rein in Paul's reckless bidding habits while Bogart's away making wedding plans. Rick preaches caution, but Cindy goes for the big score.

Cindy and Rick search for fresh lockers at an auction in Toronto. Unforeseen expenses force Ursula to reconsider her attitude about stripping. Roy crashes hard. Paul and Bogart experience the merciless negotiations of Jeff Schwarz: The Liquidator.

To his own amusement, Roy brings a mime to an auction in Corktown. Rick and Cindy arrive in a foul mood, Bogart hopes to whip Paul into shape, and Ursula aims to skewer the competition. Later, Roy gets a weather lesson from BT's Frank Ferragine.

The buyers head to Utopia hoping that the auction lives up to its name. Roy is flush with cash and is not afraid to bribe. Ursula runs afoul of some fowl, Rick and Cindy must atone for their sins, and Paul and Bogart uncover some true dough.

programmes.st: Three Kennys Are Worse Than None
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart arrive at an auction with a new “secret weapon:” Paul's inexperienced brother Barry.

Roy shows his nephew what being an instigator is all about at an auction in South Etobicoke. Bogart wants a new catch-phrase. Rick's pirate shtick grates on Cindy's nerves, but that's nothing compared to what they get from director Kenny Hotz.

Bogart's hooked on goji berry juice and plans to spread the word at an auction in Milton. Roy is in all white, looking to spread distraction. Cindy's mind is on the lockers, but Rick's is in the gutter. Ursula has a bonsai to pick with her locker.

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.
After blowing a date with Gary (Pete Davidson), Sheila (Kaley Cuoco) discovers a time machine & loops back to fix everything.
In the aftermath of a tragedy, Harper retreats to the English countryside hoping to heal.

Mikey Saber (a magnetic Simon Rex) — a charismatic con man and washed-up porn star — plots his return to the big time from small-town Texas in this wild, fiercely funny portrait of an American hustler and a hometown that barely tolerates him.

Dr. Alithea Binnie is an academic, a creature of reason. But while in Istanbul, she encounters a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom. At first, she doubts him, but eventually she makes a wish... one that surprises them both!

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

The unseen side of a great American myth in Priscilla Presley's turbulent relationship with Elvis. Sofia Coppola (The Virgin Suicides) tells a deeply felt and ravishingly detailed portrait of love, fantasy, and fame through her eyes.

Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.
When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

A championship ballroom dancer finds inspiration within, and decides he'll stop at nothing to win, even if it means rewriting the rules. A worldwide feel-good hit, with an incredible soundtrack, from director Baz Luhrmann (MOULIN ROUGE!).
Two strangers meet and fall in love during the weekend that they are planning their respective weddings.
When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!
Based on the classic 1868 novel about love, family, and the female spirit, Louisa May Alcott tells the domestic saga of the March family.

1994 Oscar Winner: Best Cinematography. Based on the novella by Jim Harrison, this sweeping romantic epic is about the Ludlow brothers--two men (Brad Pitt, Aidan Quinn) in love with the same woman (Julia Ormond). Rated: R
Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.
In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

Athos is kidnapped and taken back to his estate of Pinon. The Musketeers search for him and find themselves in the middle of a battle against a nobleman who's shocked by Athos' decision to reject his nobility and determined to seize the land for himself.

Astronomer Marmion gathers the Royal household to his observatory in a transformed old fort to watch a solar eclipse. The Musketeers and Rochefort escort them but could never have predicted the twist in fate that ensues and the choices that must be made.

The King's cousin is ambushed whilst under Musketeer escort as she travels to make a political marriage that will be advantageous to France. The Musketeers must quickly discover who's targeting her to keep her and the alliance between countries protected.

Porthos uncovers the truth about his parentage and demands answers from his newfound father. As he learns more about his past Porthos questions his place in the Musketeers regiment. Musketeers have suspicions about Porthos' new family.

The Musketeers must put their lives on the line when the Queen is accused of treason. They have no choice but to steal her away from the Palace to safety, while they search for evidence to prove that Rochefort is a Spanish spy.
When Clarissa kidnaps the younger children of King Henry and Queen Catherine, Mary and Bash work with the Queen to find them, with tragic results.
With a forced marriage looming, Mary must consider both her heart and her nation when deciding whom she will wed - Francis or Bash - when Francis returns to court with Lola at his side.

Mary returns from her honeymoon and, suspicious of Lola's strange behavior, uncovers a deception that changes everything.  Bash encounters a confused and terrified Olivia, an escaped victim of the terrors of the woods.
The castle is abuzz with First Light, where the women of the castle mingle with potential suitors. Much to Mary's dismay, Lola is reluctant to participate in the tradition.

When Francis reluctantly agrees to help Bash uncover the threat in the woods, he ends in grave danger, with only Bash to save him. Meanwhile, the King's madness causes chaos when a servant wins "Queen for the Day".

When Mary learns of a secret clause in her marriage contract that her mother, Marie de Guise and Queen Catherine orchestrated, Mary and Francis embark on a dangerous plan to turn Scotland against her mother.
When Mary's brother James arrives in France and convinces Mary to return to Scotland, Francis is suspicious and uncovers a plot that would destroy Mary, which causes a rift between them.

When Mary's uncle, the Duke of Guise, arrives in France with devastating news about her mother, Mary and Francis realize they are torn between putting their own countries first or saving their marriage.

Mary enlists a mercenary to help her, which forces her to realize there are sacrifices and lives she is willing to risk to save her country.  Francis embraces his role as Dauphin to lead France in a brutal battle against England.

Mary and Catherine form an unlikely alliance when deciding how to deal with the increasingly manic King Henry, which puts Francis in jeopardy. Bash finds a boy who lived to tell about his encounter with the Darkness.

When the King's madness and cruelty reaches a fevered pitch, Mary and Francis take action. Their choices could change the course of history, but an unforeseen terror brewing in the woods could cost them, and their friends, everything.
Astrid gets an unexpected visit from her alternate, while Peter and Olivia track a killer using a toxin that has yet to be invented.
The Fringe team becomes trapped in a strange town.
Investigating a mentally ill patient connected to a series of murders, Olivia uncovers some frightening connections and shocking revelations.
Pivotal events unfold for Peter and the Fringe team.
The Fringe Team tracks a killer who targets love.
An unfamiliar case is familiar to Peter.
Lincoln works a case "over there" with the Alt Fringe team.
Walter travels to the Alternate Universe to help Broyles.
In this mind-bending episode, the story jumps ahead to 2036 when the Fringe team strikes back against the Observers in a game-changing battle.
The Cortexiphan children surface with new developments.
A case of spontaneous combustion forces Walter to revisit his painful past, while the Fringe team faces off against David Robert Jones to save the world — or worlds.

Cortney Lake is a young single mother and beauty pageant contestant who gets caught up in an abusive relationship. When her mother returns home from a barbecue and Cortney isn't there, she knows something is wrong.
Ali Gilmore was a graduate of Florida A&M who worked two jobs and is held in high regard by everyone who knows her. But her complicated romantic life only comes to light after she goes missing.
The foster parents of 4-year-old Oakley Carlson reluctantly accept it when they must surrender her back to her biological parents. But when she disappears they begin a frantic search for answers.
Jon Riley loves sailing, rock climbing and the great outdoors. But when he goes missing and a human foot washes up in a nearby lake, his family fears the worst. Only, it's not Jon's. So where is he?
Where is Susan Walsh? The list of those who might have meant her harm is impressive - the Russian mob, the Mafia, a vampire cult, and a jealous estranged husband.

Best friends Maisy Odjick and Shannon Alexander go missing after a school dance. When police label the girls as runaways, Maisy's family picks up the search.
When Chase Hurdle walks out of high school one morning, his family wonders if he's experiencing amnesia or if something more sinister has happened.
An abandoned car raises new questions about whether it was Chase or someone else who was seen jumping from a Bismarck bridge. Did Daniel Olson come to town to start over, or end it all?
When 22-year-old Mackenzie Trottier doesn't show up for Christmas, her family panics. Police hunt for an unidentified man connected to the missing woman.
Single mom Kassandra Ramirez just started her dream job as a chef. But she told a relative, I think I'm in danger. Then she vanishes.
Mechanical genius Granger Taylor leaves a note for his parents, announcing that he is going on an interstellar voyage aboard an alien spaceship. He is never seen again.
Ryan Shtuka disappears after a house party during a fierce winter storm. Everyone was searching. How could a promising 20-year-old simply vanish?

programmes.st: Kristen Galvan, Bissonnet Street, Part One

programmes.st: Echo Lloyd, Echo in the Ozarks

programmes.st: Justin Rutter, The Ghost of Lowertown
programmes.d: When 14-year-old Justin Rutter doesn't come home one night, his family panics. Police think he's a runaway, but evidence suggests something more sinister.

programmes.st: Irene Gawka, American Dream, American Nightmare

programmes.st: Dylan Rounds, Stranger in a Strange Land, Part One

programmes.st: Dylan Rounds, Stranger in a Strange Land, Part Two

programmes.st: Aubrey Dameron, A Bright Star Dimmed

programmes.st: Max Devries: Nightmare In Paradise P2

programmes.st: Molly Miller And Colt Haynes - Lost In Love County

As the spring melt sweeps the mountains, Jake sets his sights on bagging a black bear for the larder; Eustace and Raleigh race against time and weather to plant crops; Mike sets out to harvest a bounty from the Gulf of Alaska.

Mike flies into the Kodiak backcountry in search of rich bear hunting grounds; Jason rushes to complete a barn before his new herd of goats arrive; Kidd and Harry hunt down the bear that attacked their cattle.
Kidd and Harry go toe to toe with a one-ton bull; Eustace and Raleigh dig deep for Turtle Island's food stores; Mike braves the Kodiak interior on a bear scouting mission.

In the Meltdown finale, Mike escapes the bear-ridden Kodiak interior on foot; Jake runs a lion on foreign ground; Josh does battle with a prairie dog colony; Jason takes his kids' outdoor survival lessons to new extremes.

Tom Oar tries to save a friend's water supply and hunt his winter's meat surrounded by grizzlies. Eustace Conway deals with the threat of someone trying to take his land.

Weighing over 1300 pounds, the colossal marlin is one of the most storied predators in the ocean. Armed with a sword-like bill, it's super powerful and can explode out of the water, causing chaos and even serious accidents on boats.

Cyril has heard that although super-dangerous, the waters surrounding the remote archipelago of the Bissagos Islands in Guinea-Bissau are home to a fish known for putting up a brutal fight: the Cubera.

Cyril has heard disturbing stories of people being accidentally injured and even killed by the huge jumping Gulf Sturgeon - and its even bigger cousin, the White Sturgeon, is the most massive freshwater fish in North America, growing to over 1500 lbs.
Cyril is in the Bahamas on a perilous mission to track down the biggest predator he's ever faced: a giant tiger shark.
An electric eel can emit a devastating, 700-volt shock to kill its prey. But is this enough to kill a human, like locals in the amazon say it is?
Eustace's fight with Justin reaches a boiling point while Tom loses his way high in the Rockies and Marty fights the elements as he tries to get home.

Tom Oar must put his work on hold while he tries to find winter meat and protect himself from looming predators.
